versions.name: Expressive studio
versions.description: Bold typography, playful interaction, and a vivid sculptural centrepiece.
versions.alt: Expressive studio design with bold typography and an orange sculptural form.

versions.name: Cinematic technology
versions.description: Light, atmosphere, and precision. An immersive world of engineering.
versions.alt: Dark cinematic design with luminous typography and an orbital sculpture.

versions.name: Refined editorial
versions.description: Warm paper, expressive serif type, and carefully composed details.
versions.alt: Editorial design with warm ivory, burgundy serif typography, and architectural artwork.

versions.name: Spatial walk
versions.description: A scroll-driven walk through a 3D space that enacts the forward-deployed argument. Built in Three.js and React.
versions.alt: Dark spatial design with amber accents, serif headline and a translucent 3D pane.

versions.name: Spatial walk, LinkedIn theme
versions.description: The same spatial walk in the LinkedIn palette: navy, white and brand blue, with the mark exactly as it appears on LinkedIn.
versions.alt: Navy spatial design with white serif headline, blue accents and the LinkedIn W mark.

versions.name: City
versions.description: A miniature city where each district is a service, explored by camera as you scroll. Concept by Raghvendra.
versions.alt: Dark design with a miniature 3D city of instanced buildings and a central spire.

versions.name: Iris
versions.description: A ceramic intelligence with a nine-blade mechanical eye, now with a design-style switcher and WebsiteSoft's own services. Concept by Raghvendra.
versions.alt: Dark design centred on a ceramic sphere with a nine-blade mechanical eye.

versions.name: One story
versions.description: One 3D scene runs the whole page: a website is built, launched and grown chapter by chapter, with five switchable themes. Concept by Ripudaman.
versions.alt: Monochrome design with a 3D website being assembled on a grid floor.

versions.name: Studio
versions.description: A static HTML and Three.js site in the LinkedIn palette, with inner pages for services, CMS work and contact. Concept by Ripudaman.
versions.alt: Navy design in the LinkedIn palette with the W mark and a 3D scene.
